newsitem.title: USA: U.S. exporters report soyoil sold to unknown - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. exporters report soyoil sold to unknown - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Monday said private exporters reported sales of 20,000 tonnes of soybean oil to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.
The marketing year for soybean oil begins Oct 1.
USDA issues both daily and weekly export sales reports.
Exporters must report to USDA sales of 20,000 tonnes or more of soybean oil made in one day to a single destination by 1500 ET the next business day after the sale.
Sales of lesser quantities must be reported weekly.
